The Company had earlier incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary viz., ESG GREEN ENERGY PRIVATE LIMITED and agreed to make further investment along with the other group captive consumers where post-acquisition, shareholding of the Company will be 73.98% of the equity share capital in the above subsidiary. Pursuant to this the Company had made first tranche of investment in the wholly owned subsidiary ESG GREEN ENERGY PRIVATE LIMITED along with the group captive consumers during October 2025, resulting in the percentage of shareholding of the Company reducing from 100% to 65.78% as at the end of the quarter ended December 31, 2025, which changed the status of ESG GREEN ENERGY PRIVATE LIMITED from being a wholly owned subsidiary to a subsidiary of the Company.
To reflect the correct aggregate holding percentage of shares or voting rights as at the end of the quarter ended December 31, 2025, the percentage of shares or voting rights acquired during the quarter is mentioned in negative value as -34.22 % which actually pertains to the shareholding of the other group captive consumers in the subsidiary company.
